name: Windows DXGI 1.2 Stereo 3D
summary: System-level stereoscopic framework introduced with Windows 8 (DirectX 11.1) as a vendor-agnostic 3D API. Allows the OS to manage the 3D swapchain directly. Natively used by the Windows Store (UWP) version of Rise of the Tomb Raider.
compatibility_notes: Still present in Windows 11 but the '3D Display Mode' toggle only appears if the OS detects a display with a specific 3D EDID. Modern spatial displays (Acer SpatialLabs, Samsung Odyssey 3D) are not recognized. Community tool 3D Game Bridge bridges this gap for supported displays.
